The Meta-ControlNet in Phidias dynamically modulates the conditioning strength based on the similarity between the 3D reference and the concept image. This modulation is crucial for handling misaligned references during training, as it ensures the model does not overly rely on potentially erroneous geometric details from the reference. By adjusting gradients according to alignment and noise levels, the model can maintain consistency across different views while avoiding overfitting to poor references. Option D accurately describes this mechanism, as it incorporates a learned weighting matrix that scales gradients based on both the noise level and feature similarity, allowing for controlled generation at different stages of the diffusion process.
